acceptOwnership().notice: Accept the nomination to be owner.

addSynth(address).notice: Add an associated Synth contract to the Synthetix system

allowance(address,address).notice: Returns the ERC20 allowance of one party to spend on behalf of another.

approve(address,uint256).notice: Approves spender to transfer on the message sender's behalf.

availableSynthCount().notice: Returns the count of available synths in the system, which you can use to iterate availableSynths

balanceOf(address).notice: Returns the ERC20 token balance of a given account.

burnSynths(bytes4,uint256).notice: Burn synths to clear issued synths/free SNX.

collateral(address).notice: The total SNX owned by this account, both escrowed and unescrowed, against which synths can be issued. This includes those already being used as collateral (locked), and those available for further issuance (unlocked).

collateralisationRatio(address).notice: The current collateralisation ratio for a user. Collateralisation ratio varies over time as the value of the underlying Synthetix asset changes, e.g. if a user issues their maximum available synths when they hold $10 worth of Synthetix, they will have issued $2 worth of synths. If the value of Synthetix changes, the ratio returned by this function will adjust accordlingly. Users are incentivised to maintain a collateralisation ratio as close to the issuance ratio as possible by altering the amount of fees they're able to claim from the system.

debtBalanceOf(address,bytes4).notice: If a user issues synths backed by SNX in their wallet, the SNX become locked. This function will tell you how many synths a user has to give back to the system in order to unlock their original debt position. This is priced in whichever synth is passed in as a currency key, e.g. you can price the debt in sUSD, XDR, or any other synth you wish.

effectiveValue(bytes4,uint256,bytes4).notice: A function that lets you easily convert an amount in a source currency to an amount in the destination currency

exchange(bytes4,uint256,bytes4,address).notice: Function that allows you to exchange synths you hold in one flavour for another.

initiateSelfDestruct().notice: Begin the self-destruction counter of this contract. Once the delay has elapsed, the contract may be self-destructed.

issueMaxSynths(bytes4).notice: Issue the maximum amount of Synths possible against the sender's SNX.

issueSynths(bytes4,uint256).notice: Issue synths against the sender's SNX.

maxIssuableSynths(address,bytes4).notice: The maximum synths an issuer can issue against their total synthetix quantity, priced in XDRs. This ignores any already issued synths, and is purely giving you the maximimum amount the user can issue.

nominateNewOwner(address).notice: Nominate a new owner of this contract.

remainingIssuableSynths(address,bytes4).notice: The remaining synths an issuer can issue against their total synthetix balance.

removeSynth(bytes4).notice: Remove an associated Synth contract from the Synthetix system

selfDestruct().notice: If the self-destruction delay has elapsed, destroy this contract and remit any ether it owns to the beneficiary address.

setSelfDestructBeneficiary(address).notice: Set the beneficiary address of this contract.

setSynthetixState(address).notice: Set the synthetixState contract address where issuance data is held.
